issues.source_quote: Нет, я никуда не еду. Мы провожаем папу!!!
issues.translation_quote: No, I'm not going anywhere. We're seeing Daddy off!
issues.justification: Acceptable, but the following 'Фрис-стрит, рыбна улица' rehearsal with 'Аптека Чиканук' is garbled; the translation 'Fris Street, Fish Street' loses the deliberate mispronounced gibberish of the gang's passphrase.

issues.source_quote: Чтоб ты жил на одну зарплату!
issues.translation_quote: May you live... on nothing... but your salary!
issues.justification: The punchline curse (the worst fate: living on a salary alone, as a corrupt/black-market person) is reduced to awkward, over-punctuated phrasing; the humor and the preceding curse structure ('Чтоб я видел тебя у гробу, у белых тапках') are weakened, and the Yiddish-inflected speech is lost.

issues.source_quote: Простите, погорячился...
issues.translation_quote: Sorry, I got carried away...
issues.justification: Minor loss only; more significant is that the bracketed gibberish pseudo-foreign dialogue is transliterated rather than rendered, so the joke of fake foreign language mixed with Russian subtitles partly survives, but 'Щёрт побери' (accented 'Damn it') is flattened to plain 'Damn it', losing the accent comedy.

issues.source_quote: Щёрт побери, щёрт побери!
issues.translation_quote: Damn it, damn it!
issues.justification: The foreign-accented mangling of the password is the running gag; the translation renders it identically to the correct form, so the joke (the wrong man recognizing the password) disappears.

issues.source_quote: Эти кретины уверяли, что он был без сознания... Значит, этот лопух ничего не знает.
issues.translation_quote: Comrade! AI-lyulyu would be lovely, but tsigel-tsigel! Time's running out! Those idiots swore he was unconscious...
issues.justification: 'Товарищ, товарищ... время, товарищ!' is the speaker's line pressed to the foreigners, and the translation garbles the nonsense phrases, introducing 'AI-lyulyu' with odd capitalization and an unnatural sentence that does not match the source.

issues.source_quote: Облико морале… ферштейн?
issues.translation_quote: Morale impeccable! Verstehen?
issues.justification: Pseudo-foreign 'Облико морале' (moral character) is meant as the speaker's comic mixture; 'Morale impeccable' misrepresents it. Moreover 'Руссо туристо' is kept as 'Russo touristo!' but the point 'Soviet tourists behave morally' is blurred.

issues.source_quote: Упал, выругался... Чёрт возьми! Ух, прости, "Чёрт побери!"
issues.translation_quote: you fall, you swear... "God damn it!" Oh, sorry: "Damn it!"
issues.justification: The joke is that the password is exactly 'Чёрт побери' and he mistakenly says a variant 'Чёрт возьми'; 'God damn it' vs 'Damn it' is not a comparable near-miss and introduces 'God', which is stronger and unrelated.

issues.source_quote: Чтоб я видел тебя у гробу, у белых тапках!
issues.translation_quote: I hope I see you in your coffin, wearing your little white slippers!
issues.justification: Acceptable meaning but the speaker's comic Odessan/Yiddish dialect ('у гробу, у белых тапках', 'исдох') is flattened to standard English, losing character voice.

issues.source_quote: Ах глаз - ерунда, пройдёт!
issues.translation_quote: Oh! The eye's nothing. It'll heal!
issues.justification: Fine, but earlier 'Кутузов!' (a one-eyed general reference) is left untranslated and unexplained, so the joke is lost.

issues.source_quote: Строго на север, порядка... 50-ти метров, расположен туалэт, типа сортир, обозначенный на схеме буквами «Мэ» и «Жо».
issues.translation_quote: marked "M" and "W" on the map
issues.justification: 'М' and 'Ж' (men's/women's) are the joke because the speaker pronounces them 'Мэ' and 'Жо' (a crude-sounding pun); 'M' and 'W' loses the comic mispronunciation.

issues.source_quote: Кто возьмёт билетов пачку, тот получит... Водокачку!
issues.translation_quote: Buy a stack of tickets, and you'll win... A water pump!
issues.justification: The rhyme (пачку/водокачку) that makes this a parody lottery slogan is lost.

issues.source_quote: Нет, на это я пойтить не могу!
issues.translation_quote: No! I can't go along with that!
issues.justification: The deliberately uneducated, comic register ('пойтить') of the speaker is lost.

issues.source_quote: Вы в самодеятельности участвуете?
issues.translation_quote: Do you do amateur dramatics?
issues.justification: The Soviet 'самодеятельность' (amateur arts clubs) is a cultural reference that is anglicized; 'amateur dramatics' narrows it.

issues.source_quote: Куй железо, не отходя от кассы!
issues.translation_quote: strike while the iron's hot... without leaving the till!
issues.justification: The mangled idiom is the Boss's trademark gag, rendered reasonably, but subsequent uses keep the same wording well; this is acceptable. However the earlier 'Хм, на одну зарплату на такси не разъездишься...' is rendered as a flat statement and the later 'Ку-ку' toasts are unexplained.

issues.source_quote: Чёрт побери
issues.translation_quote: God damn it!
issues.justification: Adds unwarranted 'God', raising the profanity level.

issues.source_quote: Вы говорите: поскользнулся, упал... закрытый перелом
issues.translation_quote: slipped, fell... closed fracture
issues.justification: Fine, but 'У тебя там не закрытый, а открытый перелом' keeps the pun; however 'открытый' as 'open fracture' misses that Nadya is hinting at the open secret/gold, which is acceptable. No issue.

issues.source_quote: Такова «сё ля ви», как говорят у них...
issues.translation_quote: That's "c'est la vie," as they say over here...
issues.justification: 'over here' is wrong: 'у них' means 'over there/where they live'; also the pidgin 'сё ля ви' is the joke.

issues.source_quote: Пейте. Пейте, пейте...
issues.translation_quote: Drink. Go on, drink...
issues.justification: Fine; but 'Ай-й... Ouch...' interjections are loosely rendered and the 'Ooh... Ouch...' inventions add noise.

issues.source_quote: Без сознания... Потерял сознание, очнулся - гипс
issues.translation_quote: Passed out, came to... A cast!
issues.justification: Fine overall; but 'Он согласился? - Согласился!' is okay. No issue.

issues.source_quote: Нью-Йорк-город контрастов
issues.translation_quote: New York: A City of Contrasts.
issues.justification: Acceptable; however the housing-office official's bureaucratic Soviet voice ('ЖЭК', 'Красный уголок') is rendered as 'housing office' and 'Red Corner' without explanation, losing cultural flavor but acceptable.

issues.source_quote: Сеня... А ты Софи Лорен видел? ... К-к... [фигня]
issues.translation_quote: R-rubbish.
issues.justification: Reasonable. No issue.

issues.source_quote: Пьянству - бой!
issues.translation_quote: Down with drunkenness!
issues.justification: Fine. No issue.

issues.source_quote: Печёнкой чую, клюнула настоящая рыба.
issues.translation_quote: I can feel it in my bones: we've hooked the real fish.
issues.justification: 'Печёнкой' (in my liver/gut) is replaced with 'bones', a minor shift.

issues.source_quote: Если вы нам понадобитесь… Вы ко мне приедете. Если мы Вам будем нужны… Я вызываю такси на своё имя.
issues.translation_quote: If we need you... You'll come to me. If you need us... I'll order a taxi in my name.
issues.justification: The roles are garbled: the colonel says if we need you, I order a taxi (they come); if you need us, you come. The translation reverses the arrangement, confusing the plot.

issues.source_quote: Козлодоев... Козадоев! Казладоев!
issues.translation_quote: Kozlodoyev. Kozodoyev! Kozlodoyev!
issues.justification: The name is consistently rendered 'Kozodoyev' early (Козадоев) while 'Козлодоев' (goat-molester pun) is the joke; the translation fails to render the wordplay, and the introduction spelled it Kozodoyev, losing the insult.

issues.source_quote: Жешка на 19-ой версте
issues.translation_quote: The woman at the nineteenth kilometer
issues.justification: 'Жешка' is a hideout/slang, unclear; translated as 'woman'. Also 'верста' is not a kilometer.

issues.source_quote: Как говорит наш дорогой шеф, за чужой счёт пьют даже трезвенники и язвенники.
issues.translation_quote: even teetotalers drink when someone else is paying... and even ulcer sufferers!
issues.justification: The punchline structure is broken by the awkward ellipsis, weakening the Boss's aphorism.

issues.source_quote: Бойся тот, кто...
issues.translation_quote: I knew too much
issues.justification: Fine. No issue.
